newsitem.title: USA: America Online unveils search site.
newsitem.headline: America Online unveils search site.

text.p: America Online Inc on Thursday unveiled a directory service to help computer users find information on the Internet.
At the Internet World trade show, the nation's biggest online service also unveiled the newest version of its software, which features better messaging software and easier searching capabilities.
America Online's search site, called AOL NetFind, lets computer users look up phone numbers and addresses and search for specific text within sites on the World Wide Web.
The site would compete with Yahoo Inc's search sites.
